profile.positioning: I’m the Founder & CEO of RemitFlow, a next-generation cross-border payments platform leveraging the efficiency and transparency of stablecoins. We're tackling the exorbitant costs and frustrating delays inherent in traditional remittance systems, particularly for individuals and businesses operating between Africa and Asia. RemitFlow isn’t just about lower fees; it's about unlocking economic opportunity by enabling faster, more reliable access to capital. Having spent several years building and scaling a mobile money platform in Kenya, I witnessed firsthand the transformative power of accessible financial services. RemitFlow builds on that experience, utilizing blockchain technology to create a truly inclusive and efficient payment infrastructure. We’ve achieved significant initial traction in pilot programs, demonstrating a 40% cost reduction compared to conventional methods, and are now focused on expanding our network and securing strategic partnerships. I’m particularly interested in connecting with individuals who can offer insights into regulatory frameworks, stablecoin integration, and scaling fintech solutions in emerging markets. I'm always open to discussing how RemitFlow can collaborate to reshape the future of global payments.
